description: This file defines a PHP trait 'CryptoParamsTrait' in the AWS SDK for S3 encryption, providing utility methods for handling cryptographic parameters, especially related to metadata strategies and materials providers within the AWS SDK context.

methods.name: getMaterialsProvider
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the MaterialsProvider object from input arguments.

methods.name: getInstructionFileSuffix
methods.description: Determines the instruction file suffix from arguments or defaults.

methods.name: determineGetObjectStrategy
methods.description: Selects the appropriate metadata strategy based on object metadata.

methods.name: getMetadataStrategy
methods.description: Determines and returns the metadata strategy object based on provided arguments and instruction file suffix.
